evidence: Honey-to-dark-brown 'tiger' mottled barrel beads (about 45-66), dark disc spacers plus gold filigree ball spacers, vase/gourd shahid in the same material with collar rings, gold 22k-style tassel: 3 chains ending in Ottoman tughra gold coins, with red and turquoise stones and a red knot. No hero in any gallery has brown tiger barrel beads. ROS-049 has round orange beads and British sovereign coins (different beads and coins). ROS-Amb-G-034 has glittery brown goldstone-like barrels on a white cord. ROS-Amb-G-062/-033/-066/-043 were also ruled out.

Opaque lemon/olive-yellow barrel-round beads with flattened ends and small round spacer beads. One-piece shahid: a cone with a double collar ring over a straight cylinder base. Red knot. Long silver (925) tassel of anchor-link and box chains with filigree caps and green cabochon stones. No yellow-green opaque piece in any gallery. ROS-Amb-G-024 has dark olive glittery cylinders, orange disc spacers and a composite shahid. ROS-045 has veined onion-shaped beads. ROS-047 is egg-yolk orange with a double-gourd shahid. Not the same piece as v16 (see v16).

Olive yellow-green mottled spherical beads (long string, about 66-99) with ribbed biconvex lens spacers. Long-necked bottle-gourd shahid with a collar ring at the bulb. Red cord tail with about 6 small beads, a fluted melon bead and a double-gourd end piece. The 'ROS-1' in the file name is the videographer's own numbering, NOT catalog ROS-001 (a wooden rosary). It is a DIFFERENT piece from v11: the bead shape (true spheres vs flat-ended barrels), spacers (lens discs vs small round beads), shahid (bottle gourd vs cone-and-cylinder column) and bead count all differ. A restring would not change any of these. Only the material and colour are similar. No catalog hero is this colour. ROS-047 has a similar layout (lens spacers, long tail) but is vivid orange with a different shahid.

About 33 round beads, each sharply split half opaque orange / half dark green, some with clear amber zones. Disc spacers in the same material. Long column shahid with waist and collar rings, green knot, silver kazaz braided tassel with 3 woven knot balls. The hinted candidate ROS-Amb-G-003 is a different piece: green-dominant beads with orange swirls (marbled, no clean split), larger beads, gold granulated filigree spacers, a composite shahid of round beads with ring discs, and a gold braided tassel.

33 mustard-ochre butterscotch barrel beads (flat-ended drums with darker streaks, glowing orange when backlit) plus 2 smaller round spacer beads. Short gourd shahid with a flat top lip and collar ring. Red knot. Silver kazaz braided tassel with woven silver balls and white seed-bead flower clusters. Closest is ROS-KS-140 (similar colour, 33 oval beads), but its beads are egg-shaped ovals, it has thin disc spacers, and its shahid has a narrow tip and long bulb with a white flake. Rejected. ROS-Amb-G-041/-012/-032/-035/-037/-042/-044/-061/-075/-078, ROS-043, ROS-KS-030/-063/-103/-104/-142 were also ruled out on bead shape, count or shahid.

About 66 round orange beads speckled with red dots and cream patches ('munammash'), with a few double-barrel spacers (two small barrels joined by a ring). Long turned shahid: cap, flare, bulb, triple ring, bottom bulb. Red knot, 3 gold braided cords with a gold slide and gold end caps. Candidates rejected: ROS-Amb-G-030 (about 45 larger cream-crackled beads, ribbed silver ball spacers, composite round-bead gourd shahid). ROS-Amb-G-029 (large plain butterscotch beads). ROS-Amb-G-051 (gold metal shahid). ROS-048 (red faturan). ROS-KS-030 (olive beads). ROS-KS-026 (yellow onion-shaped beads). Also ROS-Amb-G-014/-015/-021/-055, ROS-005, ROS-032.
